subject: RE: Redwood walkthrough — coordination + coverage
messages:
From: Alexis Dsouza <alexis@tidalpay.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: tidalpay-ops@tidalpay.com
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood walkthrough — need to shift for exec availability

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for setting up next week's walkthrough. Our CFO and Head of Ops have a last-minute board prep and asked if we could move the live session earlier on Wednesday (originally 12/15 at 11:00am PT) to accommodate a 9:00am PT slot.

I know that's short notice — the practice here is to try and keep the live exec portion compact (20–25 mins) with a follow-up deep-dive for the engineering team. If we can do 9:00am PT, that would be ideal for execs; otherwise we'll have to push to next week.

Are there 9:00am PT slots available on your end? Also, could you confirm who from Redwood would lead the exec segment vs the technical deep-dive? We'd prefer the SE who owns routing and caching to be on the technical portion.

Best,
Alexis
Alexis Dsouza
Head of Partnerships, TidalPay

Attachments: walkthrough-agenda.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: Alexis Dsouza <alexis@tidalpay.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:35:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Redwood walkthrough — need to shift for exec availability

Alexis — thanks for flagging and for the flexibility. Short answer: we can try to make 9:00am PT work. A couple of notes:

- Karthik (SE) is the subject-matter lead on routing/cache and was slated for the technical deep-dive. He is traveling that morning for an onsite and is not available until ~1:00pm PT.
- Marissa can cover the exec portion and run the live demo; she knows the performance/SLAs well and can handle the Q&A. She can also lead the recording for the technical walkthrough if we split it.

Options I propose (quick):
1) Move full session to 9:00am PT with Marissa leading live exec + condensed technical Q&A (20–25 mins), and schedule a separate recorded deep-dive with Karthik for engineering later that day (or early next week).
2) Keep the original 11:00am PT slot and request execs to join late (not ideal).
3) Run an abbreviated 9:00am PT exec demo (Marissa), then schedule a 45-min technical session at 1:30pm PT when Karthik is back. We can record both.

Marissa — can you confirm you can own 9:00am PT exec live and take the ops questions? If so, I will patch Alexis and tidalpay-ops into a calendar update and update the HubSpot activity.

Alexis — if you prefer the single-session experience, let me know and I'll see if we can make room for Karthik to dial in remotely from travel (he's trying to avoid heavy travel on that morning).

Thanks — Connor
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0128

Related links: https://cal.com/connor/tidalpay-demo

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, Alexis Dsouza <alexis@tidalpay.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Redwood walkthrough — need to shift for exec availability

Connor / Alexis — happy to take the exec slot at 9:00am PT. Happy to run the live portion and focus on latency/cost/SLAs. I suggest the following structure for the compressed exec session:

- 0–5m: quick intros and goals (you + Alexis execs)
- 5–20m: demo of hosted API + Dedicated routing example (Marissa)
- 20–25m: ops questions and immediate next steps

For the technical team: Karthik, can you confirm whether you can pre-record a 20–30m walkthrough (covering routing policies, cache warmup, and canary handback strategies) before you travel tonight? If so, we can play the recording immediately after the exec demo and hold a live Q&A at 1:30pm PT. If you can't record, we'll run the separate deep-dive next week.

Also: Connor, I'll need the SOW draft and the final agenda to include a short slide about Dedicated capacity guarantees. I see a draft SOW in the shared folder — please attach.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-draft-Redwood.docx (DOCX, 78KB)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai, Alexis Dsouza <alexis@tidalpay.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:47:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Redwood walkthrough — need to shift for exec availability

Thanks all — quick update from my side before you finalize: I'm on a red-eye travel that lands 12:10pm PT on 12/15 and I'll have spotty connectivity until I clear the airport. I can do either:

A) Pre-record a 20–25m technical walkthrough tonight (I have time after dinner) that covers routing, KV caching, and the canary handback pattern; Marissa can play it during the session and I'll join live at ~1:30pm PT for Q&A.
B) If you need a true live technical demo that day I'm not a reliable option; we should schedule the engineering deep-dive for the following week (I can do M/Tu morning).

I prefer A (pre-record + live Q&A) to avoid dropping off while on a cab/phone. If you'd like, I can include a short config example and an exporter snippet so your eng team can validate token-level cost numbers.

Markus — flagging in case you want to approve Marissa covering the exec segment and the split session approach for the pre-record + Q&A. Also confirming there are no SLA or discount implications for splitting the session.

On a separate note, Connor — after the demo we should log a HubSpot task for a follow-up technical deep-dive and include the recording in the engagement timeline.

Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
